title: Planet with rings with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="planetGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd966"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ffb347"/>
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#e8823a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c96a2e"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- back part of ring -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="46" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#7ec8e3" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="80 260" stroke-dashoffset="-10" transform="rotate(-18 50 55)"/>
  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="27" fill="url(#planetGrad)"/>
  <!-- subtle highlight band -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="42" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#ffe9a8" opacity="0.55"/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="48" rx="3.4" ry="4.2" fill="#5a2d0c"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="48" rx="3.4" ry="4.2" fill="#5a2d0c"/>
  <circle cx="42.3" cy="46.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff6d8"/>
  <circle cx="60.3" cy="46.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff6d8"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="58" r="3.6" fill="#ff8f6b" opacity="0.75"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="58" r="3.6" fill="#ff8f6b" opacity="0.75"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 58 Q50 68 58 58" fill="none" stroke="#5a2d0c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- front part of ring -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="46" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#8fd8f0" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="90 260" stroke-dashoffset="0" transform="rotate(-18 50 55)"/>
</svg>
